title: ModuleTaskRepository
responsibility: Commit module task definitions and claims atomically in a dedicated Git ref while preserving source HEAD and the working index.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository working-tree root used to construct the Git adapter.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.update.change
inputs.description: Synchronous callback applied to a JSON-cloned queue. It may be invoked again, up to 16 times, after a concurrent compare-and-swap loss; it should be replay-safe and avoid external side effects.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.update.source
inputs.description: Optional source commit added as a parent of the queue commit. When no prior queue exists and source is omitted, current HEAD is used as the parent.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.sync.remote
inputs.description: Configured Git remote name matching the repository's accepted remote-name pattern.

inputs.name: syncTaskQueue.git
inputs.description: Git boundary used for fetch, ancestry checks, task-ref updates, push and temporary-ref cleanup.

inputs.name: syncTaskQueue.ref
inputs.description: Queue ref to exchange, normally refs/harness/tasks.

inputs.name: taskOwner.git
inputs.description: Git boundary used to locate the common Git directory for this clone.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.read
outputs.description: Reads refs/harness/tasks and parses queue.json with queueSchema. If the ref is absent, returns commit undefined and an empty version-1 queue.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.update
outputs.description: Applies change to a cloned, schema-validated queue and commits only when its stable JSON changes. It compare-and-swaps refs/harness/tasks against the commit read; concurrent changes trigger a fresh read and callback retry, up to 16 attempts. A successful change writes a Git plumbing commit without changing source HEAD or the index. The queue commit has the previous queue commit as parent and includes source when supplied; the initial commit otherwise parents current HEAD. A no-op returns the existing queue commit.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.sync
outputs.description: Synchronizes refs/harness/tasks with one configured remote. Fast-forwards the local task ref when the remote is ahead, keeps local history when local is ahead, pushes the resulting local ref, and rejects divergent histories without merging them. Uses and removes a temporary fetch ref; it does not merge source branches.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRepository.owner
outputs.type: Promise<{workspace: string; pid: number; startedAt: string}>
outputs.description: Returns the persisted clone identity, current process ID and process start time. The identity is stored in the common Git directory at harness/task-owner-id with mode 0600.

outputs.name: syncTaskQueue
outputs.type: (git: GitAdapter, ref: string, remote: string) => Promise<{remote: string; commit: string | undefined}>
outputs.description: Implements the repository sync behavior described for ModuleTaskRepository.sync. The temporary incoming ref is removed in a finally block.

outputs.name: taskOwner
outputs.type: (git: GitAdapter) => Promise<{workspace: string; pid: number; startedAt: string}>
outputs.description: Creates or reuses a UUID clone identity in the Git common directory, validates it, and combines it with the current process ID and ProcessIdentityAdapter.find(pid).startedAt.

outputs.name: featureSchema
outputs.description: Strict object with id, goal and tldr. The id is a lowercase unit-style identifier up to 150 characters; goal and tldr are trimmed non-empty strings up to 16000 characters.

outputs.name: wantedContractSchema
outputs.description: Strict object with responsibility text, inputs, outputs and errors. Each contract item has required trimmed non-empty name and type, optional description and optional examples containing JSON values; outputs must contain at least one item.

outputs.name: taskInputSchema
outputs.description: Strict object with id, title, feature id, module id, instructions and wantedContract. moduleGoal and verificationFiles are optional; verificationFiles are limited to 64 safe relative paths that name a test or verification fixture. model is a trimmed non-empty string up to 150 characters and defaults to auto. provider is optional claude or codex; intelligence is optional low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra; assignee is an optional unit-style id. Text fields are trimmed non-empty strings up to 16000 characters.

outputs.name: storedTaskSchema
outputs.description: Strict stored task object based on ModuleTaskInput without its feature and module input fields. It replaces feature with TaskFeature and module with {id, goal, files}, then requires a 40-character lowercase sourceCommit, 64-character lowercase contractHash, status queued/running/review/failed/accepted and ISO createdAt. repairCommit is optional; reviews, claimHistory and attempts default to empty arrays; claim and result are optional. Result execution/usage and review item shapes depend on the unresolved task-usage dependency contract.

outputs.name: queueSchema
outputs.description: Strict object {schemaVersion: 1, features: TaskFeature[], tasks: ModuleTask[]}; features are capped at 1000 and tasks at 10000. It validates shape and bounds, not unique IDs or cross-record feature relationships.

outputs.name: TaskUsage
outputs.description: Authoritative alias imported from repository.agents-providers-module-task-repository-task-usage. Its field shape is absent from that dependency's committed contract; do not infer it.

outputs.name: TaskExecution
outputs.description: Authoritative alias imported from repository.agents-providers-module-task-repository-task-usage. Its field shape is absent from that dependency's committed contract; do not infer it.

outputs.name: TaskApiCost
outputs.description: Authoritative alias imported from repository.agents-providers-module-task-repository-task-usage. Its field shape is absent from that dependency's committed contract; do not infer it.

outputs.name: TaskFeature
outputs.description: Parsed feature record; id follows the unit-style identifier rule and goal/tldr are trimmed, non-empty text up to 16000 characters.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskInput
outputs.type: {id: string; title: string; feature: string; module: string; moduleGoal?: string; verificationFiles?: string[]; instructions: string; wantedContract: WantedContract; model: string; provider?: 'claude' | 'codex'; intelligence?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max' | 'ultra'; assignee?: string}
outputs.description: Parsed task definition. Model defaults to auto. Verification paths are safe relative test or verification paths, capped at 64. Top-level schema is strict.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskQueue
outputs.description: Parsed queue record; schema limits features to 1000 and tasks to 10000.

outputs.name: ModuleTask
outputs.type: Omit<ModuleTaskInput, 'module' | 'feature'> & {feature: TaskFeature; module: {id: string; goal: string; files: string[]}; sourceCommit: string; contractHash: string; status: 'queued' | 'running' | 'review' | 'failed' | 'accepted'; repairCommit?: string; reviews: TaskReview[]; createdAt: string; claim?: TaskClaim; claimHistory: TaskClaim[]; result?: StoredTaskResult; attempts: StoredTaskResult[]}
outputs.description: Parsed stored record. files must be non-empty safe relative paths. TaskClaim has worker id, UUID token, ISO startedAt, and owner {workspace UUID, positive pid, startedAt text}. Reviews and result usage/execution fields are inferred from the unresolved task-usage dependency schema. Array defaults are applied by the schema.

outputs.name: TaskSelection
outputs.description: Exact selected provider, model and intelligence carried by runner calls.

outputs.name: TaskRunInput
outputs.type: TaskSelection & {cwd: string; prompt: string; signal: AbortSignal}
outputs.description: Input to a TaskRunner implementation.

outputs.name: TaskRunResult
outputs.type: TaskSelection & {text: string; reportedModel: string | null; usage?: TaskUsage}
outputs.description: TaskRunner result before persistence-specific task fields are added.

outputs.name: TaskRunner
outputs.description: Provider execution interface.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown when feature, task, stored task or queue data fails its Zod schema.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Propagated when the queue commit's queue.json is not valid JSON.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Propagates Git adapter, filesystem and callback errors; also reports a repeatedly changing task queue after 16 failed compare-and-swap attempts, divergent remote task histories, invalid remote names, malformed owner identities, or inability to establish a process start time.
